exposure: infants born extremely preterm (<27 weeks' gestation)
time period (before vs. after implementation of dedicated team)
cohort: The study included 1,064 infants born < 30 weeks' gestation in a French tertiary perinatal center between 2007 and 2020.
finding: Birth during the on-call period was not significantly associated with survival without severe morbidity or mortality in very premature infants overall.
